messages:
pagerbot: 🚨 PagerDuty: High error rate detected for inference-gateway-usw2. Trigger: 5xx rate > 3% (1m). Pager: SRE rotation. PD link: https://pd.local/INC-6883332221
jamal: acked. pulling up dashboards now. any obvious recent deploys?
alex: there's a small canary that went out ~10m ago to eu-west1 but traffic should be routed elsewhere. checking logs for 502 patterns.
maria: customers reporting timeouts in support queue. no pager for customer impact yet but seeing retries.
jamal: logs show a spike of `502` with upstream connection resets from kv-cache-proxy. look at this tail:
```
[2026-03-17T03:07:11Z] inference-gateway: upstream_connect reset=1 backend=kv-cache-proxy-4 err="connection reset by peer"
[2026-03-17T03:07:12Z] inference-gateway: request_id=abc123 status=502 latency=12.1ms
```
jamal: rolling diagnostic checklist: 1) confirm routing, 2) check kv-cache cluster health, 3) temporarily divert non-critical traffic to fallback model pool.
elena: I'm on standby to take handoff in 25m. jamal — if this looks like kv-cache OOM, we should evict small prefixes and scale cache.
ajam: (typo) jamal: also seeing TCP RST spikes between gw and cache in us-west2 -> likely network flapping on that peering. pinging infra.
infra-bot: Notified infra-networking: ticket NET-2334 created.
alex: quick mitigation: enabling fallback route to read-through mode (no cache) for 10% of traffic to reduce pressure. patch:
```
route.rules.cache_policy = "bypass-read-through"
route.traffic_split = {"primary": 90, "read-through": 10}
```
alex: monitoring error rate now. sending a rollback of canary as precaution.
maria: support: flagging top 3 customers experiencing errors, sending templated status notice.
jamal: oncall: if error rate doesn't drop in 5m, escalate to full-rotation. for now keeping PD suppressed for noisy rules.
pagerbot: Update: suppression applied for low-priority noisy alerts; critical alerts still flow.
elena: taking over primary oncall. jamal handing off: summary -> kv-cache proxy resets causing 502s, temporary read-through route enabled, canary rollback initiated, infra engaged (NET-2334). my plan: keep read-through, increase cache pool by +2 nodes if RSTs persist, otherwise revert to normal routing after stabilization.
jamal: thanks — I've DM'ed runbook link and added the rollback diff. :thumbsup:
elena: will update timeline and post customer impact note if error rate > 1% for next 10m.
alex: error rate down to 1.8% in last 1m (was 4.6%). latency stable. good signal.
maria: support confirmed reduced tickets after toggling read-through. customers on affected routes seeing fewer retries.
pagerbot: Auto-update: 5xx rate=1.6% (1m). Event still open.
elena: if we keep trending down, plan to remove read-through and scale back by 30m. if not, escalate to infra for deeper network forensics. tagging @infra-networking and @platform-ops.
jamal: handing complete. closing my terminal, ping if anything urgent.
elena: got it. will do a final handover note once stabilized. :white_check_mark:
